# Cherubim

> Cherubim is autonomous AI penetration testing that finds an application's
> real vulnerabilities and proves each one with a working exploit, not a guess.

Cherubim is a product of Hesed & Emet Advisory, a Singapore advisory working
where AI, cybersecurity and human behaviour collide.

## What Cherubim does

- Autonomous pentesting: point it at a URL, hostname or wildcard domain and it
  runs a complete engagement on its own, no agents or appliances to install.
- Exploit verification: every candidate vulnerability is reproduced in an
  isolated sandbox and attached to the finding as a working proof of concept.
  If it cannot be reproduced, it is not reported, so you get evidence, not
  false positives.
- 22-phase methodology: reconnaissance, subdomain discovery, fingerprinting,
  transport security, authentication, session management, access control and
  IDOR, SQL and NoSQL injection, XSS, SSRF, command injection, file upload and
  path traversal, XXE and deserialization, API security, business logic, rate
  limiting, information disclosure, cloud and infrastructure, headers and CORS,
  client-side analysis, exploit verification, and reporting.
- Live observability: a real-time stream of tool invocations, agent reasoning,
  HTTP activity, phase transitions and findings as they are proven.
- Integrations: a REST API, a GitHub app that reviews pull requests, CI/CD
  gating that breaks the build only on proven findings above a severity
  threshold, scheduled scans, and an open-source CLI.
- Reporting: branded reports with an executive summary, severity breakdown,
  proof of concept and remediation, plus signed share links for stakeholders.

## Key facts

- Category: autonomous AI penetration testing, application and API security,
  exploit-verified DAST.
- Differentiator: no proof, no finding. Every issue ships with a working
  exploit, a CVSS score, a CWE and OWASP mapping, and a fix.
- Safety: non-destructive payloads with rate-limit protection, safe to run
  against production. Typical single-target scan completes in 10-30 minutes.
- Data protection: row-level isolation, TLS in transit, no training on customer
  data, user control over export and deletion.
- Region: Singapore and Asia Pacific.
- Contact: hello@hesedemet.asia
